name: Pip Mudwhistle
descr: Pip Mudwhistle grew up in the tunnels of a cavern city, where he learned that every lock has a weakness and every guard has a price. He talks his way into trouble and slips out through the shadows.

features.name: Amphibious
features.text: You can breathe and move naturally underwater.

features.name: Long Tongue
features.text: You can use your long tongue to grab onto things within Close range. **Mark a Stress** to use your tongue as a Finesse Close weapon that deals **d12** physical damage using your Proficiency.

features.name: Low-Light Living
features.text: When you're in an area with low light or heavy shadow, you have advantage on rolls to hide, investigate, or perceive details within that area.

hopeFeature.name: Rogue's Dodge
hopeFeature.text: **Spend 3 Hope** to gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion until the next time an attack succeeds against you. Otherwise, this bonus lasts until your next rest.

features.name: Cloaked
features.text: Any time you would be _Hidden,_ you are instead _Cloaked._ In addition to the benefits of the _Hidden_ condition, while _Cloaked_ you remain unseen if you are stationary when an adversary moves to where they would normally see you. After you make an attack or end a move within line of sight of an adversary, you are no longer _Cloaked_.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.text:
When you succeed on an attack while _Cloaked_ or while an ally is within Melee range of your target, add a number of **d6s** equal to your tier to your damage roll.

- Level 1 → Tier 1
- Levels 2-4 → Tier 2
- Levels 5-7 → Tier 3
- Levels 8-10 → Tier 4

foundations.name: Shadow Stepper
foundations.text: You can move from shadow to shadow. When you move into an area of darkness or a shadow cast by another creature or object, you can **mark a Stress** to disappear from where you are and reappear inside another shadow within Far range. When you reappear, you are _Cloaked._

specializations.name: Dark Cloud
specializations.text: Make a **Spellcast Roll (15).** On a success, create a temporary dark cloud that covers any area within Close range. Anyone in this cloud can't see outside of it, and anyone outside of it can't see in. You're considered _Cloaked_ from any adversary for whom the cloud blocks line of sight.

specializations.name: Adrenaline
specializations.text: While you're _Vulnerable,_ add your level to your damage rolls.

masteries.name: Fleeting Shadow
masteries.text: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your Evasion. You can use your "Shadow Stepper" feature to move within Very Far range.

masteries.name: Vanishing Act
masteries.text: **Mark a Stress** to become _Cloaked_ at any time. When _Cloaked_ from this feature, you automatically clear the _Restrained_ condition if you have it. You remain _Cloaked_ in this way until you roll with Fear or until your next rest.

inventory.name: Grappling Hook
inventory.descr: A collapsible iron hook on a length of knotted cord.

domainCards.name: Pick and Pull
domainCards.descr: You have advantage on action rolls to pick nonmagical locks, disarm nonmagical traps, or steal items from a target (either through stealth or by force).

domainCards.name: Inspirational Words
domainCards.descr:
Your speech is imbued with power. After a long rest, place a number of tokens on this card equal to your Presence. When you speak with an ally, you can spend a token from this card to give them one benefit from the following options:

- Your ally clears a Stress.
- Your ally clears a Hit Point.
- Your ally gains a Hope.

When you take a long rest, clear all unspent tokens.

appearance.clothes: Patched leathers with far too many pockets

data.background: Pip ran messages, and occasionally other people's purses, through the twisting tunnels of his underground home. A deal gone sour forced him to the surface, where the sky still makes him dizzy. Despite being a ribbet, he hates deep water and refuses to swim, a secret he guards closely.
data.connections:
- What did I recently convince you to do that got us both in trouble?

- What have I discovered about your past that I hold secret from the others?

- Who do you know from my past, and how have they influenced your feelings about me?
